utility.notes: The City of Ukiah operates its own municipal electric utility (a City department, NCPA member, operator of the Lake Mendocino Hydroelectric Plant), confirmed via the city's own Electric Utility page. generation_supplier.notes: No CCA was found serving Ukiah this session; as a municipal utility with its own renewable generation mix (over 38% geothermal/hydroelectric as of 2021), Ukiah generally would not participate in a CCA.
